stages.label: hear the claim
stages.text: Bell trusts you with the courthouse claim.

stages.label: compare deeds
stages.text: You compare the public deeds instead of repeating a rumor.

stages.label: settle fairly
stages.text: Bell resolves the claim fairly and offers a market introduction.

stages.label: share a cast
stages.text: Rose shows you the quiet bend.

stages.label: trace the current
stages.text: You map a safe current together.

stages.label: return the lure
stages.text: Rose leaves a river guide in your tackle roll.

stages.label: inspect the rail
stages.text: Bill asks you to inspect the safe side of the old rail.

stages.label: mark safe ground
stages.text: You mark the dangerous ground without making a spectacle.

stages.label: retire the fuse
stages.text: Bill retires the fuse and teaches a composed opening.

stages.label: read the auction board
stages.text: Ada explains which bids are fair.

stages.label: sort seed sacks
stages.text: You help Ada rescue a mixed seed order.

stages.label: open the ledger
stages.text: Ada opens her seed ledger and joins the farm roster.

stages.label: inspect the barn
stages.text: Gideon introduces the animals by name.

stages.label: mend the tack
stages.text: You mend the tack before the evening game.

stages.label: keep the roster
stages.text: Gideon takes a place on the daily animal roster.

stages.label: review testimony
stages.text: Elise lets you review a disputed testimony.

stages.label: index records
stages.text: You index records so a claimant can be heard.

stages.label: file the correction
stages.text: Elise files the correction and shares a civic lead.

stages.label: walk the beat
stages.text: Mara asks you to walk the practice-hall beat.

stages.label: post the notice
stages.text: You post a clear, accessible table-night notice.

stages.label: call fair play
stages.text: Mara calls fair play and stands ready for the championship.

stages.label: check the manifest
stages.text: Ves shows you the dock's public manifest.

stages.label: weigh the cargo
stages.text: You weigh a shipment without shaving its count.

stages.label: close the ledger
stages.text: Ves closes the ledger and backs your honest trade.

stages.label: read the tide
stages.text: Coral teaches you to read the lantern tide.

stages.label: mend the net
stages.text: You mend a net before the fog settles.

stages.label: light the cove
stages.text: Coral marks a lantern cove on your chart.

stages.label: study the ruins
stages.text: Ash asks you to read the weathered stones.

stages.label: tend the bonfire
stages.text: You tend the bonfire through an uneasy weather shift.

stages.label: name the witness
stages.text: Ash records a final witness statement for the coming confrontation.
